intro: Chengdu is the last big city before the mountains, which is what makes it interesting. Two international airports work a basin ringed by terrain, so approach control is busier and more constrained than the flat-country equivalents. The conventional railways out toward Baoji and Kunming still run analog dispatch radio. And if you are heading west onto the plateau, this is where you sort out your radio setup, because past Ya'an the infrastructure thins out fast.
introz: 成都是进山之前最后一座大城市，这正是它有意思的地方。两座国际机场在被山地环抱的盆地里运行，进场管制比平原机场更繁忙、约束更多。往宝鸡和昆明方向的普速铁路仍在使用模拟调度电台。如果你要往西上高原，这里就是把电台配置弄妥的地方——过了雅安，基础设施会迅速稀疏。

stations.d: The newer of the two airports, opened in 2021 and now handling most long-haul traffic. Set the VX-6 to AM and sweep.
stations.dz: 两座机场中较新的一座，2021 年启用，目前承担大部分远程航班。把 VX-6 设为 AM 后扫描。

stations.d: Closer to the city and easier to receive from an apartment. Mostly domestic and regional now.
stations.dz: 离市区更近，在公寓里更容易收到。现在以国内和区域航班为主。

stations.d: Two airports plus surrounding terrain make this a genuinely complex terminal area. Approach and departure are constantly interleaving arrivals from both fields.
stations.dz: 两座机场加周边地形，使这里成为相当复杂的终端区。进离场管制不断交叉排序两个机场的航班。

stations.d: Enroute traffic across Sichuan and out over the plateau. From Longquan Mountain the reach is considerable.
stations.dz: 覆盖四川及往高原方向的航路流量。在龙泉山上覆盖范围相当可观。

stations.d: Worth keeping in a scan list in mountainous regions, where terrain and weather cause more diversions.
stations.dz: 在山区值得放进扫描列表，因为地形和天气会导致更多备降。

stations.n: 无线列调 — Baocheng and Chengkun lines
stations.z: 无线列调 · 宝成线与成昆线
stations.d: The old Baoji–Chengdu and Chengdu–Kunming routes are engineering landmarks — long tunnel sequences and spiral climbs — and still run conventional analog dispatch. Scan 450–460 MHz near the line for driver and dispatcher traffic.
stations.dz: 老宝成线和成昆线是工程史上的里程碑——连续长隧道和螺旋爬升——至今仍使用普速模拟调度。在沿线扫 450–460 MHz 可听到司机与调度的通话。

stations.z: 无线列调 · 配对频段
地铁与高铁 · 数字制式

stations.n: 公众对讲机 — sweep all 20 channels
stations.z: 公众对讲机 · 20 个信道全扫
stations.d: Very active around Kuanzhai Alley, Chunxi Road and the panda base — tour guides, crowd management and shop staff. Also the band self-drive convoys use heading west.
stations.dz: 宽窄巷子、春熙路和熊猫基地一带非常活跃——导游、人流管理和店员。往西自驾的车队也用这个频段。

stations.n: 公众对讲机 Ch 19 — convoy channel
stations.z: 公众对讲机 19 频道 · 车队频道
stations.d: The upper channels are what organised convoys tend to move to once they realise channel 1 is unusable. If you are driving west in a group, this is the practical choice.
stations.dz: 有组织的车队意识到 1 频道没法用之后，通常会转到靠上的信道。如果你们组队往西开，这是现实的选择。

stations.n: 成都交通广播 — traffic radio
stations.d: The single most useful station in the region. Landslide closures, tunnel status and mountain road conditions on the routes west — information that is often not on any app yet.
stations.dz: 本区最实用的电台：滑坡封路、隧道状况和西行山路路况——这些信息往往还没出现在任何手机应用上。

stations.d: Provincial traffic stations usually put their frequency in the name, so a slow sweep tells you what you have.
stations.dz: 各省交通广播通常把频率写进台名，所以慢慢扫一遍就知道能收到什么。

stations.d: Sichuan has an active amateur community with real emergency-communications experience from the 2008 earthquake onward. Worth making contact with the provincial 无线电协会 before a plateau trip.
stations.dz: 四川的业余无线电群体很活跃，自 2008 年地震以来积累了真实的应急通信经验。上高原之前，值得先联系省无线电协会。

stations.d: Chengdu has repeaters with useful coverage from the hills east of the city.
stations.dz: 成都东侧山上的中继台覆盖不错。

stations.d: Nature reserves such as Wolong and the Qingcheng–Dujiangyan area run their own VHF nets for patrols and fire watch. Assignments are not published — scan 150–170 MHz once you are inside a reserve.
stations.dz: 卧龙、青城山—都江堰等自然保护区有自己的 VHF 通信网，用于巡护和防火。频率不公开——进入保护区后扫 150–170 MHz。

stations.d: Trekking companies working Siguniang Shan and the Bipeng valley use consumer radios, mostly on the 409 MHz band but occasionally imported sets elsewhere.
stations.dz: 四姑娘山和毕棚沟一带的徒步公司使用民用对讲机，多数在 409 MHz，偶尔也有进口设备在其他频段。

stations.d: Pucheng is not far northeast, so reception in the Sichuan basin is reliable.
stations.dz: 蒲城就在东北方不远，四川盆地接收稳定。

stations.d: Difficult in the basin because of terrain and haze. Much better once you are on the plateau.
stations.dz: 盆地里因地形和雾霾比较困难，上了高原会好得多。
